title: Vue Router: routes, guards, nested views and lazy loading

videos.script:
So far the planner has had one screen. Today it gets addresses. {{why}} A page for the week, a page for each course, and a page for an address that leads nowhere. Each one can be bookmarked, shared, and reached with the back button.

You install Vue Router, pinned, and give the application a router. {{routes}} Then the three pieces every routed app has. Routes, which pair a path with a component. RouterView, where the matched page is drawn. And RouterLink, a link that changes the page without reloading it.

{{params}} Then parameters. One route, one component, a page per course. {{nested}} Then a page inside a page, with two lists under one heading.

{{guards}} Then guards. An address for a course that does not exist is sent to the not found page, and the tab's title follows every move.

{{lazy}} Then lazy loading, and the separate files it makes in the build. {{history}} And last, what happens when somebody reloads a course page on a server that was never told about your routes.
